brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided al-Zawiya shrine, the Ma'an news agency reported, seizing money and establishing checkpoints in the area. The troops conducted what witnesses characterized as a raid involving the confiscation of funds from the religious site.

The operation included the erection of military barriers and confrontations with residents, according to the report. Details of the specific location and number of people affected were not immediately specified.
title: Israeli forces raid shrine, seize funds and detain residents
